response.claim: Explicit consent is required to adjust credit from refund, failed, or reversed transactions already paid for beyond the lower of one percent of the credit limit or Rs 5,000; consent must be sought within 7 days of the credit, and on cardholder request reversal to the bank account must occur within 3 working days.
